description: Search memories: hybrid BM25 + vector fusion with deterministic sub-millisecond retrieval.

cold_scan_limit.description: Maximum cold records to scan when include_cold is set (default 2048)

galaxy.description: Galaxy to search in, or 'all' for cross-galaxy discovery

historical.description: Include superseded or archived records (default: false)

limit.description: Maximum number of memories to return (default: 10)

min_score_ratio.description: Relative floor: reject hits below this fraction of the top score

query.description: Search query or natural language question

since.description: Inclusive lower time bound: RFC3339 or epoch seconds

until.description: Inclusive upper time bound: RFC3339 or epoch seconds

name: memory.search
title: Search Memories
